author: reek
body: A label whose text is far wider than the node holding it must stop at the node's right edge.

author: reek
body: **The third row is the calibration and it is the reason to believe the second.** `gop-draw-text` is called directly at the same origin with the same string, and it MUST escape -- it is the unclipped primitive the clipped path is built on. Without that arm, "outside: no" is satisfied by a renderer that drew nothing at all, and the first row alone cannot tell those apart because it only looks inside the box.
